aggregate_proposal_observation.notes: Observed directly from JSON without importing src/lib/data. All ten explicit deadlines are 2026-12-31 driveaway-price facts. Parent reports 277 current serialized summaries; this audit did not rerun catalogue generation.

timezone_assessment: Australia/Sydney is a defensible documented conservative mainland-AU calendar-date fallback when source timezone is unavailable. Explicit source-local deadlines and closing-time terms should take precedence when known. Keep UTC-roundtrip validation/date arithmetic separate from choosing the current evidence date. A minute timer can update up to about one minute after a date boundary in an active tab; background throttling may extend this.
boundaries: Conditions are retained as a whole when one clause expires; current dated conditions examined are limiting historical/source terms, but future affirmative timed amount claims in conditions need their own dependency/expiry association. Whole-model freshness and source snapshot guards were inspected; this is not a complete application security or catalogue audit.
post_fix_result: No remaining actionable blocker found within the requested cached-summary deadline/SSR scope. All three reproduced gaps are closed. Discovery withholds all numerical rank fallback before browser clock readiness; untimed editorial summaries remain server-rendered.
